title: Adversarial Human Review Necessity Triage v1
summary: JがREVIEW_REQUIREDとして残した各exact-anchor unresolved findingに対し、DAとCounter-DAを別レンズで実行し、impact・causal reach・perspective gapから人間の注意を今使うべき理由を査定する。低価値判定でも証拠は捨てず、v1では自動DROP権限を持たない。
original_problem: Jは85件中9件を安全に自動解決したが76件を保留した。76件を全部人間が同じ優先度で読むと新モデル追従時間が長い。一方、単純なnoise filterや平均scoreでは、低い即時impactでも後でH/F/Gへ効く因果経路や、DAとCounter-DAの評価差そのものを見落とす。
why_it_matters: 人間の判断力を本当に必要なUNKNOWNへ集中させるには、semantic correctnessを自動決定する前に、なぜ人間が見る価値があるのかをimpact・future causal reach・adversarial disagreementで順位付けする必要がある。
reason_frozen: DAとCounter-DAを平均して disagreement を消す、高いcausal reachを低い即時impactだけでdeferする、marketing語を理由に同一anchor内のexecution-contract signalまで捨てる、unresolved itemをsilent dropする、truncated/stale inputを通常判定する、triageから実行権限を生やす、という失敗をDAで禁止するまで実装しない。
preserved_value: one input unresolved finding produces one triage record
DA and Counter-DA remain separately inspectable
impact and causal reach are distinct dimensions
perspective disagreement increases rather than decreases review priority
low immediate impact can still be HUMAN_NOW when causal reach is high
noise signals cannot override explicit execution-contract signals
upstream truncation and stale fingerprints fail closed
no automatic DROP authority in v1
trigger_conditions: RTS-FRZ-000020 Semantic Claim Refinement + Review Reduction v1 is COMPLETED
J preserves unresolved exact anchors and source identity
A-J are COMPLETED and WIP is clear
negative_triggers: DA and Counter-DA scores are averaged into a single hidden consensus
high perspective disagreement lowers review priority
high causal reach is auto-deferred solely because immediate impact is low
marketing/noise text suppresses an explicit contract-change signal in the same anchor
truncated or stale upstream input produces a normal triage result
dependencies: RTS-FRZ-000020 Semantic Claim Refinement + Review Reduction v1
possible_destinations: future model-assisted DA/Counter-DA proposer behind deterministic verification
human attention queue for transition review
